# Madeirabook

> Madeirabook is a local booking platform for Madeira, Portugal: ocean-view apartments, villas and holiday homes booked directly from local hosts. The platform charges 10% commission instead of the 15–20% charged by global platforms, and returning guests get −10% forever. The site also publishes data-driven travel guides: real flight prices from 17 European cities, where to stay, what to eat, and island safety facts.

- [Home](https://www.madeirabook.com/): Book ocean-view apartments in Madeira directly from local hosts. Best price guaranteed, no platform fees.

## Stays

- [Madeira apartment rentals](https://www.madeirabook.com/madeira-apartment-rentals): Ocean-view apartments from local hosts, direct booking, no Airbnb fees.
- [Apartamentos do Mar, Lido](https://www.madeirabook.com/apartamentos-do-mar): Ocean-front apartments in Lido, Funchal — same promenade as 5-star hotels, half the price.
- [Penthouse View Ocean, Caniço](https://www.madeirabook.com/penthouse-view-ocean-canico): 3-bedroom penthouse, 120 m², sleeps 9. Direct from local host.
- [Madeira ocean-view apartments](https://www.madeirabook.com/madeira-ocean-view-apartments): Balconies facing the Atlantic, direct from local hosts.
- [Madeira villa rentals](https://www.madeirabook.com/madeira-villa-rentals): Private villas with pool and ocean view — Calheta, Ponta do Sol.
- [Madeira holiday homes](https://www.madeirabook.com/madeira-holiday-homes): Family-friendly holiday homes, direct booking, no platform fees.
- [Madeira hotel deals](https://www.madeirabook.com/madeira-hotel-deals): Independent and chain hotels in Funchal, Lido and Calheta with local recommendations.
- [Funchal short-term rentals](https://www.madeirabook.com/funchal-short-term-rentals): Best areas for tourists — Lido, Old Town, São Gonçalo. Prices, pros and cons.
- [Caniço self-catering](https://www.madeirabook.com/canico-self-catering): Apartments with full kitchens and ocean views on the quiet coast.
- [Lido, Funchal](https://www.madeirabook.com/lido-funchal): 10 km ocean promenade, heated ocean pools, 5-star hotels — the best area to stay.
- [Where to stay in Madeira](https://www.madeirabook.com/where-to-stay-madeira): Best areas for tourists compared — Funchal, Lido, Caniço, Calheta.

## Guides

- [Madeira travel guide 2027](https://www.madeirabook.com/madeira-guide): Complete trip planner — cheapest weeks to fly, where to stay, what to eat.
- [Best time to visit Madeira](https://www.madeirabook.com/best-time-to-visit-madeira): Weather, water temperature, crowds and prices month by month.
- [Do you need a guide in Madeira?](https://www.madeirabook.com/madeira-guide-replacement): Probably not — rent a car from €30/day and see 10x more.
- [Madeira events calendar](https://www.madeirabook.com/madeira-events-calendar): Carnival, Flower Festival, Atlantic Festival, Wine Week, New Year fireworks.
- [Christmas swimming in Madeira](https://www.madeirabook.com/madeira-christmas-swimming): Swim in the Atlantic in December — +22°C while Europe freezes.
- [Is Madeira safe?](https://www.madeirabook.com/madeira-safety): The safest island in Europe — no snakes, scorpions, venomous spiders or dangerous sharks.
- [Madeira history](https://www.madeirabook.com/madeira-history): Timeline from the 1419 discovery through the sugar trade to 1976 autonomy.
- [Madeira tours & experiences](https://www.madeirabook.com/madeira-tours): Curated food, wine and 4x4 tours with real reviews, from €52.
- [Madeira food guide](https://www.madeirabook.com/madeira-food-guide): Espetada, espada, bolo do caco, limpets, poncha and Madeira wine.
- [Where to eat in Madeira](https://www.madeirabook.com/where-to-eat-madeira): Michelin-starred William and Il Gallo d'Oro plus TheFork deals 30–50% off.
- [Espetada](https://www.madeirabook.com/espetada): Madeira's signature beef skewer on bay laurel — history, recipe, where to try.
- [Poncha](https://www.madeirabook.com/poncha): The national drink — sugarcane rum, honey and lemon. Recipe and history.
- [Madeira wine tasting](https://www.madeirabook.com/madeira-wine-tasting): Sercial, Verdelho, Bual, Malmsey — vineyards, cellars and tours.
